description_full: Faraday Copper Corp., a resource exploration stage company, engages in the acquisition, exploration, and development of mineral properties in the United States. The company holds 100% interest in the Copper Creek project consisting of 81 square kilometers of private land, patented and un-patented mining claims, and state prospecting permits located in Pinal County, Arizona. It also holds 100% interest in the Contact Copper Project comprising 155 patented claims covering an area of approximately 11 square kilometers, and 294 unpatented claims that cover an area of approximately 19 square kilometers situated in Elko County, Nevada. The company was formerly known as CopperBank Resources Corp. and changed its name to Faraday Copper Corp. in April 2022. Faraday Copper Corp. was incorporated in 2014 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.

financial_summary: FARADAY COPPER CORP. is a small-cap basic materials business with a $804M market cap on $0 of annual revenue.
Returns on capital run at -153% against a 9% cost of capital, which means the business is destroying value with every dollar it reinvests.
The company is burning through $20M of cash, and without positive owner earnings any valuation rests on hope rather than evidence.

Net dilution runs at 4.3% annually, transferring value from owners to stock-based comp, and insiders hold 71% of the shares, so management thinks like owners because it is one — the strongest alignment there is.
